patch_description: Use a structured symmetric initialization (concentric rings with 3-fold symmetry plus center point) followed by a direct local optimization of the exact minimum-triangle-area objective using coordinate descent with shrinking perturbation steps. The exact min over all 286 triangles is computed vectorized; points are pushed toward the boundary where Heilbronn optima live. This deterministic approach exploits known structural properties (boundary-heavy, symmetric configurations) and converges to a strong local optimum of the true objective, vastly outperforming random points.
